# `xml_max_blank_lines_between_tags`

The most blank lines kept between two tags of element-only content.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `1`

### `xml_max_blank_lines_between_tags = 0`

```ini
xml_max_blank_lines_between_tags = 0
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```xml
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
    <PropertyGroup>
      <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
        <Description>
          Kept exactly as written: MSBuild reads this whitespace.
        </Description>
    </PropertyGroup>



  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="A"/>
    <PackageReference   Include="B"   Version="1.0" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```xml
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
    <Description>
          Kept exactly as written: MSBuild reads this whitespace.
        </Description>
  </PropertyGroup>
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="A"/>
    <PackageReference Include="B" Version="1.0" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
```
:::

::::
